series.summary: L deduces Kira is a student from murder timestamps, but Light hacks his father's police database and orchestrates 23 hourly killings to bait L into turning against the police.

title: Kira Infiltrates the Police Database: Part 1

cuts.voiceover_text: A master detective tracks a supernatural killer using nothing but timestamps on heart attacks. In a dimly lit briefing room, Japanese police officers analyze the schedule of every recent murder. Then, a voice speaks through a computer bearing the letter L. The mysterious investigator delivers a chilling deduction: sixty-eight percent of the killings happen after school hours, meaning Kira is likely a high school student. The detectives stare at the monitor in utter shock.

Across town, the killer has already bypassed police security without leaving a single trace. Light Yagami sits alone in his dimly lit bedroom, quietly hacking into his police chief father’s encrypted mainframe. The confidential investigation files appear instantly across his glowing computer monitor. As Light reads L’s profile, he discovers that the authorities have already narrowed the suspect list down to high school students. His lips curl into a cold, confident smirk. The towering death god Ryuk hovers silently in the shadows behind him, watching the teenager study the exact trap set to catch him. Light now knows every secret move the task force is planning.

To shatter L’s timeline theory, Light tests a terrifying rule hidden inside the supernatural notebook. He furiously scribbles twenty-three criminal names across the lined black pages, specifying the exact hour and minute for each impending execution. Across Japan, prison clocks tick methodically forward during ordinary school hours on regular weekdays. Inside secure jail cells, twenty-three inmates suddenly clutch their chests in agony and collapse dead at precise one-hour intervals. Light watches the clock with satisfaction. He has just proven that he does not merely decide who dies, but commands the exact second their hearts stop beating.

The sudden wave of hourly inmate murders sends panic straight back to police headquarters. While the detectives assume the regular schedule disproves the student profile, L sees through the deception immediately. Kira deliberately chose only imprisoned criminals whose identities were broadcast on Japanese television. L recognizes the flawless timing as an intentional, mocking challenge. Kira is openly telling the world that confidential police intelligence has been breached.

Back in his bedroom shadows, Light reveals his ultimate psychological trap. By deliberately exposing his inside access to police data, L will suspect the detectives, and the task force will resent L’s secret surveillance. Light grins as mutual paranoia takes root. He will let the police unmask L’s true identity, then step in to eliminate him.
